summary.text: Michael Lankford is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 75 who was appointed to the seat and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Michael Lankford was appointed to Tennessee House District 75 by the Montgomery County Commission on December 8, 2025, to replace Jeff Burkhart, and assumed office on January 13, 2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 6, 2026, and faces Democrat Allie Phillips in the general election.
